description:
This episode is sponsored by https://www.snotgoblingaming.com/shop Whether you play using Games Workshop layouts, UKTC, WTC or just want to build a cool table this is the set of terrain for you! Tabletop terrain that works like Lego that you can take apart and build as you need! Made with injection molded durable ABS plastic, it's designed to last you a lifetime! Plus it can all fit into a shoe box and is available pre-painted! Unpack and build the terrain how you and your friends want and you get to playing right away! 

The Herald of the Grot Guard is back and he's brought a fully kit bashed Mad Max themed Speed Freak Ork army! Mitchell and his Black Templar can't stand for this kind of heresy. Will the Waaagh prevail or will the Templars Crusade prove to be too strong? Army lists below.
